summary: Bicycle Therapeutics plc filed a Form 8-K on April 20, 2026, under Item 8.01 to disclose a press release providing clinical updates on its nuzefatide pevedotin program and EphA2 pipeline. The release discusses Phase 1 combination data with nivolumab in metastatic urothelial cancer, dose selection for monotherapy in pancreatic cancer, and preclinical data. No financial terms, stakeholder stakes, or deal mechanics are mentioned. There is no merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or abrupt management change. Filing is a routine operational update.
